info.name: Employee & Task Management System
info.description: Full API verification collection: authentication, ADMIN user CRUD, scoped task lifecycle, dashboard, PDF reports, team options and health. Set baseUrl to http://localhost:8080 or https://employee-task-manager-api-07j1.onrender.com (no /api suffix). Use the Postman desktop app/Desktop Agent for localhost. Run the primary and additional role logins first; successful responses automatically populate collection token variables. Do not share/export populated tokens. Run user/task workflow folders in order: they create their own records and delete/soft-delete only those records. Fresh unique user emails are generated for each create workflow. Soft-deleted test users remain in history. Seed manager/employee IDs assume the original team relationships; restore demo relationships if manually changed. Clear token values before saving/exporting. Health GET/HEAD require no token. Database-outage tests are automated in the backend; do not power off the shared live database for a collection run.

item.name: Admin reads user - expect 200, no password

exec: pm.test("No credentials exposed", function () { const u = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property("password"); pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property("passwordHash"); });

item.name: Admin User Management
Edit created employee, preserve password - expect 200
Read deactivated record - expect 200, active false

item.description: Run in order after ADMIN login. Creates a unique employee and additional admin, tests edit/delete/access, then soft-deletes those new accounts. Seed users are not modified. Repeated runs leave soft-deleted history and change totalUsers.

item.name: Additional role logins
item.description: Run before cross-team task/report tests; stores manager2Token and employee2Token automatically.

item.name: Task management
item.description: Run in order. employeeToken = emp1@demo.com (id 3), employee2Token = emp3@demo.com (id 6), managerToken = manager@demo.com (id 2), manager2Token = manager2@demo.com (id 5). Use fresh tokens. This folder creates and deletes its own test task; it does not edit seeded tasks.

exec: pm.test("Combined filters narrow results", function () { pm.response.json().content.forEach(function (t) { pm.expect(t.status).to.eql("DONE"); pm.expect(t.priority).to.eql("HIGH"); pm.expect(t.assignedTo).to.eql(3); }); });

item.name: Employee: other assignee filter gives empty content

exec: pm.test("Ownership scope cannot be widened", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().content).to.eql([]); });

item.name: Other manager: cannot read created task
Other employee: cannot read created task
Dashboard
item.description: Use fresh role tokens. Compare totalTasks with task-list totalElements for the same account. Manual CRUD can change baseline seed counts.

item.name: PDF reports
item.description: Use Send and Download / Save Response to save successful PDF responses. Open each PDF and check scope, names, wrapping and page numbers. Manager report includes all tasks assigned to current team EMPLOYEEs, including ADMIN-assigned tasks; task-list/dashboard scope remains own-assigned. Manager1 should see the seed ADMIN-assigned task for employee 4 if its team relationship has not changed. Never commit tokens or real reports.

item.name: Other MANAGER own current team PDF
Team employee lookup
item.description: Assignee dropdown support. MANAGER sees only active own-team EMPLOYEEs; ADMIN sees all active EMPLOYEEs. Responses contain id/name only. managerId query cannot override scope.

item.name: Health monitoring
item.description: Read-only public probes. Keep Aiven Running for these expected-200 requests. HEAD returns no body; database failures return 503. No authentication header is used.

exec: pm.test("No body and no caching", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(""); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.include("no-store"); });
